title: Heat a meal
start_push: First, take your meal out of the fridge or freezer. That's all for now.

break_note.text: Your food has been out over 2 hours. USDA says food left out that long may not be safe to eat. Ask staff what to do.

substeps.text: Find the heating directions. Keep the package nearby
Find the time. Use that exact time (more time can burn it)
See if it says to stir or to let it stand

tips: No package (leftovers)? Use the time on your meal card, or heat 30 seconds at a time (see the last step)

steps.text: Get it ready for the microwave

substeps.text: Take off the box or sleeve
Package says heat it in the tray? Use the tray. If not, put it on a microwave-safe dish
Peel back or poke the film if the package says so

tips: Use one dish that fits and can turn freely
No package? Cover it loosely and leave a gap for steam
Not sure the dish is safe? Take a photo and ask, or use a plate you know is safe
steps.check_question: Did you use the tray or a microwave-safe dish?

steps.text: Put it in and close the door

substeps.text: Open the door (pull the handle or press the door button)
Check nothing else is inside
Put it in the middle
Close the door until it clicks

steps.text: Set the time and press Start

substeps.text: Press Cook Time (it may say Time Cook)
Press the numbers for the time
Press Start
Check the time is counting down. You may hear a hum. The light may not come on

tips: Timer does not heat food. Use Cook Time
Wrong time? Press Cancel (it may say Clear or Off) and start again
Easy way: press +30 Sec (it may say Add 30 Sec) once for each 30 seconds
Ignore the other buttons (Popcorn, Reheat, Delay Start...)
Buttons not working? The controls may be locked. On some microwaves you hold Cancel for 3 seconds. If not, ask staff

steps.text: Stir halfway, if the package says so

substeps.text: Open the door. It pauses the microwave
Use oven mitts
Stir or turn the food
Close the door and press Start

steps.check_question: If the package said to stir, did you?

steps.text: When it beeps, take it out and let it sit

substeps.text: It beeps when it's done. It may keep beeping until you open the door. That's OK
Use oven mitts. The dish is hot
Lift the cover away from your face. The steam is hot
Let it sit a few minutes, or the time on the package

steps.text: Check it's hot all the way through

substeps.text: Stir it
Look for steam in the middle
Take a small first bite. Some spots can be very hot

tips: Not hot in the middle? Press +30 Sec and check again
Have a food thermometer? It should say 165°F
steps.check_question: Was it hot all the way through?
